name: Goodfellas Laughing
look: A film still from Goodfellas. Ray Liotta as Henry Hill, in a cream suit jacket, laughs hysterically with his mouth wide open and his hands clutched at his chest. Behind him on the left, a man in a dark suit and tie throws his head back laughing. Warm bar lights glow in the background.
use: A reaction to something absurdly funny, often a friend's misfortune or a ridiculous claim. The caption sets up what is being laughed at, and the two men stand for you and your friends cracking up.
slots: what is being laughed at (top caption)
who is laughing, such as me and my friends (bottom caption)
